Olivia (CSM): FYI Sunward tokens dropped ~69% overnight. Their ML lead mentioned running a short test with NimbusAI this morning. Need renewal-risk triage. :thinking_face:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: Sunward (acct_9090) - 69% WoW. AlertID: UDF-9090-02
Ethan (AE): Noted. Who's our champion and any procurement chatter?
Olivia (CSM): Champion is Zoe. She said their SRE spun up a 1-week NimbusAI eval; no RFP yet. Zoe's been slower to reply since the drop.
Priya (SE): Quick telemetry (tokens/day):``n2027-01-08: 41,200n2027-01-09: 39,800n2027-01-10: 12,400n2027-01-11: 8,700n2027-01-12: 5,600n2027-01-13: 2,900``nPriya (SE): Playbook: 1) 20m check-in within 24h; 2) offer a 48-72h env-parity bench we host; 3) run a regression on their golden prompts and share short SLO/cost note. Lina, can you schedule?
Lina (CS Ops): Booking now. I'll include telemetry + a quick repro recipe and a proposed env-parity credit.
Ethan (AE): On the call I'll ask for Nimbus success metrics and push for a 72h side-by-side where we control infra. If they refuse, ask for same-hardware comparison or written criteria.
Priya (SE): Prep note: prefix/KV cache + pinned q4_8bit often improves p50 on retrieval-heavy flows from ~160ms->~85ms. I'll drop a 1-pager to the invite.
Olivia (CSM): Action items: Ethan - lead outreach & extract competitor metrics; Priya - upload regression + one-pager before call; Lina - book 20m and attach materials; Olivia - prep renewal-risk blurb and flag exec-escalation if they confirm replacement intent.
Lina (CS Ops): Booked 20m with Zoe for 2027-01-14 09:30 PT. Agenda: usage trend, competitor scope, parity offer. Invite contains telemetry + repro + one-pager.
